evidence.note: Established verification baseline before coding: ran full suite, counted assertion types, did per-file breakdown, and categorized invalid/malformed failure reasons — using the harness at fine granularity from the start.
MVP implement→build→run→inspect specific FAILs (br_table/loop, trap-text variants, select trap lines)→fix→rebuild→full score loop; targeted per-family localization then aggregate confirmation.
SIMD build→score SIMD json→diagnose store64_lane/module-load errors→fix→re-check non-validation SIMD failures specifically, keeping the loop per-family.

Deep drilling into individual failing assertions: hex-dumping malformed mutability/global wasm to distinguish genuine bugs from encoding mismatches, inspecting simd_lane/select invalids, and narrowing to 'remaining 3 failures'.

Treated aggregate score as a monitored signal across multiple integration points (full score at 93,141,180,198,200) and pursued exact 1.0 with 'verify individual results' and 'final verification' before declaring complete.

reasoning: The agent runs a sustained implement→run-family-json→read-specific-FAIL→fix→re-run loop for both MVP and SIMD, repeatedly runs the full aggregate runner to guard against regressions across integrations, and drills into individual failing assertions (hex dumps, specific lines) to distinguish real bugs from encoding mismatches while chasing the last few failures toward exact 1.0 — matching the engineered-verification behavior at the top of the scale. I place it at 9 rather than 10 because the terse log shows meticulous drilling mainly on the validation/encoding side, with less visible SIMD-specific semantic edge-case diagnosis (NaN/saturation/lane order).
